dedupe_keys.name: eco counter automatic pedestrian and cyclist counters with the eco visio analysis platform and api

description: Eco-Counter makes automatic counters for pedestrians, cyclists and other users of streets, trails and natural areas, and runs Eco-Visio, the cloud platform where the counters' data are stored and analysed. Coverage: counting solutions transmit data directly to the customer's Eco-Visio account, where users view hourly, daily and monthly profiles, compare volumes between sites, and produce heat maps, weekday against weekend averages, mode share and weather effect analyses, together with data quality monitoring and counter status. Format and access: data sharing runs through the REST and JSON API Evo, with keys created in the Eco-Visio account, and through Public Web Page Evo, a customised public page showing a customer's count data. Data services add validation and reconstruction of gaps, data fusion and extrapolation, custom reports and GPS track studies, and Cycling Insights, built with Geovelo, combines counts with GPS tracks to show street-by-street flows, origins and destinations, desire lines, speeds and stop locations. The company cites more than 20 years of experience with clients worldwide. Hardware, installation and platform subscriptions are sold to agencies and park managers. Licence: commercial; each customer controls its own count data, and public access depends on whether it publishes a page or shares through the API. Caveats: prices and API documentation were not read. Simulation uses: counted volumes of cyclists and pedestrians to calibrate active mobility demand and network flow models and to measure the effect of new infrastructure. Related records: TomTom traffic analytics (data-tomtom-maps-traffic-and-move-portal) for motor traffic.
